claim: The sample demo opens filled data in one click, uses demo-only storage, resets, and discards its data on exit.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter from landing; edit, reload, inspect keys, reset, and exit

claim: Edited Markdown and JSON exports include the canonical publisher URL.
sandbox: fresh demo; edit name; download both formats; inspect filenames and contents

claim: Recipe edits stay in browser storage and the demo sends no recipe data off origin.
sandbox: fresh demo; monitor requests; edit and export; inspect storage namespace

claim: The public site uses no analytics, cookies, third-party fonts, or third-party runtime scripts.
sandbox: fresh browser context; monitor all landing, demo, privacy, and terms requests, response headers, document cookies, and browser cookies

claim: Capture uses published Recipe JSON-LD rather than crawling page text or links.
sandbox: fresh demo built through the production parser from bundled Recipe JSON-LD

claim: Plus costs $12 once and adds an on-device saved card library; capture and export remain free.
sandbox: fresh landing page; inspect price, purchase type, scope, free-core copy, and production checkout target

claim: A cached valid Plus license enables saving, reopening, and removing a card from extension storage.
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts --project=desktop --grep @claim:plus-library
sandbox: fresh unpacked production extension; seed a valid daily cache and sample draft; save, reopen, and remove

claim: The sample demo reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit demo once; wait for service worker; disable network; reload and inspect sample

claim: License verification sends only the license token to the production Sociobot verification endpoint.
sandbox: mocked fetch; call license verifier; assert exact encoded production URL and request options

claim: A valid cached license is not checked more than once per day.
sandbox: fixed timestamps immediately before and at the 24-hour cache boundary
